affinity.notes: Flaming orange weapons and the ember-lit body strongly signal fire affinity.

anatomy.notes: Bipedal form, wings, horns, tail, and weapon-bearing arms read cleanly.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "dual-blade melee duelist" does not semantically communicate Four-Horn Sentence Jailer (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Two extended blades and a squared stance clearly forecast close-range sweeping attacks.

finish.notes: Armor, skin, weapons, and background lighting feel cohesive and production-ready.

framing.notes: Centered full-body stance keeps the wings, tail, and paired weapons visible.

identity.notes: Blind perception "horned winged demon" semantically identifies demons/demon-hellknight.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "boss" is outside the accepted set for intended T3.
